notes.title: Mimicry Update: Improved Matchmaking and New Season Coming Soon! 💪
notes.notes:
The latest Mimicry update is live!

What’s new:
✅ Improved matchmaking in Deathmatch mode
✅ Fixed minor bugs and issues

Plus, Season 32 is coming to an end, and Season 33 is about to begin! New items and awesome skins are waiting for you. 😎

Jump into the game, gather your team, and get ready for new battles! 🔥
